title: Italian Braised Beef Stew
description: A hearty Italian-inspired beef stew made with tender beef and flavorful vegetables, perfect for a cold winter night.
instructions: Season the beef cubes with salt and pepper.
Heat the dutch in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Sear the beef cubes until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the beef from the pot and set aside.
Add the onion and garlic to the pot and cook until the onion is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the carrots and potatoes to the pot and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the beef back to the pot, along with the pickle and beef broth.
Bring the stew to a boil, then cover the pot and transfer it to the oven.
Braise the stew in the preheated oven for 2 1/2 hours, or until the beef is tender.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley.
